payload.title: File:Chico Formation Size Chart.svg
payload.description_html: A size chart of known archosaurs of the Campanian Chico Formation of California. Left to right: Ichthyornis sp. UCMP 170785; neognathae indet. UCMP 171185, based on Presbyornis; juvenile theropoda indet. SC VRD57, based on Gorgosaurus; Hesperornis sp. SC VBHE1; pteranodontia indet. SC VRF5 & 6, based on Pteranodon. In the grid, the larger squares equal one meter.
